title: 第1994章 是我你吹得我爆吗第1993章 心很想要勉为其难收下
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: 雪天后很满意，心满意足离开。
留给众人一个潇洒背影。
“域主，她真的是天皇神朝的七公主吗？”
“废话，你看本域主何曾像今天这么没骨气，随便在一个人面前有过磕头跪地？”
“这……我怎么感觉她怪怪的，按理说，像他她这种高贵大人物应该不缺资源，可她刚才……像极了财迷？”
“嗯？原来不仅本星主有这种想法，你们也是这样想啊，她口口声声说看不上我们的东西，然而，我们送完上品源石后，连我们中品源石都说不嫌弃。”
“何止啊，我的下品源石她都说行，天啊！要不要碍于域主，本星主严重怀疑她的身份。”
“行了，收起你们无妄的猜测，本域主十分确定的跟你们说，她……确实是天皇神朝七公主。
上一次，本域主就与她会过面，身份令牌是错不了的，相信也没人敢拿天皇神朝的身份象征来坑蒙拐骗。
至于她今天的举动确实有一点点反常，不过，她应该是生了什么事情，上一回还看到她是真身行动，这一次来的只是魂身。”
青水星主沉声道
“域主，我们现在唯一想要知道的事，她今天说的话保不保真？”
“是啊！本星主可是把老底都交给她了，要是她说的提携是假的，那真的是亏到姥姥家。”
“唉！瞧你说的，我们谁不是把手中的棺材本交出？只希望天皇神朝到时候能够关注我们多一点。”
“亏你们几个还有脸说，讨好过程中，不断的拉高筹码，想把其他人比下去，最后越比越高，越堆越多，现在个个身家都拉胯了吧？”
“哼！洛老鬼，少来说风凉话，敢说第一个起哄不是你？”
洛阳星主
哑口无言！
眼前见着场面要热闹起来。
青云域主沉声发话
“行了，个个都一把年纪了，还像个菜市场婆娘一样，这像什么话？
今天我们做了这份努力，就代表着有那么一份希望，这有什么好纠结的？
据本域主所知，天皇神朝的皇主挺疼爱七公主，既然她都这么说了，那届时黄天星界大会，天皇神朝应有人来，你们需要做的是让各自旗下的天骄发挥出十二分水准。”
众星主应声
content_en:
The Snow Queen was very satisfied and left contentedly.
Leaving everyone with a chic back view.
…
"Lord, is she really the seventh princess of the Emperor's Dynasty?"
"Nonsense, do you think this domain lord has ever been so spineless as he is today, kowtowing and kneeling in front of a random person?"
"This... why do I feel that she is weird? Logically speaking, a noble and important person like him should have no shortage of resources, but just now... she looked like a money addict?"
"Huh? It turns out that not only this star master thinks this way, but you also think so. She keeps saying she doesn't like our things. However, after we gave away the high-grade Source Stone, she even said she doesn't dislike our medium-grade Source Stone."
"More than that, she said my low-grade source stone is fine. Oh my God! If it doesn't hinder the Territory Master, this Star Master seriously doubts her identity."
…
"Okay, put away your wild guesses. This domain lord can tell you with absolute certainty that she... is indeed the seventh princess of the Emperor's dynasty.
The domain lord met with her last time, and the identity token was unmistakable. I believe no one would dare to use the identity symbol of the Emperor's dynasty to deceive her.
As for her behavior today, it is indeed a little abnormal, but something must have happened to her. Last time, she was seen acting in her real body, but this time it was just her soul body. "
Lord Qingshui said in a deep voice
"Lord, the only thing we want to know now is whether what she said today is true?"
"Yes! I, the Star Master, have given all my money to her. If the support she said is false, it will really be a loss to my grandma's family."
"Alas! Look what you said, who of us didn't hand over the coffin book in our hands? I just hope that the Emperor of Heaven will pay more attention to us."
"It's a shame that you guys have the nerve to say it. In the process of trying to please, you kept raising the stakes, trying to compete with others. In the end, the competition got higher and higher, and the pile became more and more. Now everyone's net worth has been increased, right?"
"Hmph! Old Ghost Luo, don't talk sarcastically. Do you dare to say that you weren't the first one to make a fuss?"
Luoyang Star Lord
…
Speechless!
…
The scene is about to get lively before our eyes.
Lord Qingyun spoke in a deep voice
"Okay, all of them are old and still look like market ladies. What does this sound like?
We have made this effort today, which means that there is hope. What is there to worry about?
As far as the Lord of this domain knows, the Emperor of the Emperor Divine Dynasty loves the Seventh Princess very much. Since she has said so, there should be people from the Emperor Divine Dynasty coming to the Yellow Sky Star Realm Conference at that time. What you need to do is to let the geniuses under your respective banners perform to the best of their ability. "
The Lords of the Stars responded
"Yes...!"
title_en: Chapter 1994: It’s me, are you blowing me away? Chapter 1993: I really want to accept it with difficulty
